scope: Exploratory broad-event diagnostic using newly chosen baseline windows; fixed discovery ephemeris; no planet confirmation/novelty claim.
holdout_status: Retrospective pipeline-development check; no independent blind-validation claim.

configurations.control_limitations: Control boxes do not overlap primary, but overlap each other and can include phase-0.5 dimming. Primary cadences excluded from control baselines. Conditional diagnostic only.

conditional_geometry.caveat: Idealized central single-star geometry using catalog parameters and box width as approximate contact duration. Not a fitted eccentric solution. Dilution, shape bias, stellar parameter errors, other source stars, and other periods remain possible.

control_coverage_warning: Wide boxes and required side baseline severely restrict control phases, which overlap strongly and cannot establish tail significance.
